verdicts.reason: A shrinks the SOLSTICE logo to a barely legible speck jammed beside the NEW FLAVOR badge, and pushes the can off-centre to the left with dead space on its right, so the brand mark is lost. The headline is strong, but the body copy is nearly as heavy as it. B keeps the original's centred logo, can, headline and CTA order and stays faithful to the original. Its flaws are the badge crammed against the top-left edge, a lot of empty space around the can, and body copy that breaks awkwardly onto a second line, 'golden hour.'
